Lua 5.4.9, by Lua.org, PUC-Rio
https://www.lua.org
https://www.lua.org/ftp/lua-5.4.9.tar.gz
(sha256 2335b6c582a52654f94612bf10d2f4672805d05329aa6568b1d8cd9e5c6fb8e6)

These files are the release's src/ folder, unchanged, without what Bedrock
does not use: lua.c and luac.c (the stand-alone interpreter and compiler),
linit.c and the libraries a plugin is not given - liolib.c, loslib.c,
loadlib.c and ldblib.c (files, the system, loading code, debugging) - and
lua.hpp: Bedrock compiles Lua as C++, so that an error in a plugin unwinds
Bedrock's own code properly, and lua.hpp would declare it as C. Bedrock
runs its plugins in it (src/Plugins.cpp).
